title: Law No. 18 of 2017 on the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers
orig: Undang-Undang Nomor 18 Tahun 2017 tentang Pelindungan Pekerja Migran Indonesia
topic: Licensing, costs, protection before, during and after work, attachés, reintegration
latest_amendment_date_official: 2023-03-31 (UU 6/2023 on Job Creation, Lampiran Pasal 84; earlier UU 11/2020 and Perpu 2/2022). Enacted 2017-11-22.
comment: CSV 'amended' is blank but the BPK status lists amendment by the Job Creation laws. UU 6/2023 Pasal 84 amends Arts 1, 51 (SIP3MI becomes a 'Perizinan Berusaha' business licence), 53 and 57, and inserts Art 89A. Still in force ('Berlaku'). UU 27/2026 on Labour Protection repeals only Ciptaker Pasal 80(a) and Pasal 81 (the UU 13/2003 part); its text does not mention UU 18/2017. The English text on JDIH Kemnaker translates the original 2017 version, without the 2023 amendments. The CSV URL is only the site root.

title: Law No. 6 of 2012 ratifying the UN migrant workers convention
topic: Ratification of the ICRMW
comment: Matches the CSV year. Status 'Berlaku'; the BPK status section reads 'Belum Tersedia' (no amending acts listed). No official English translation of the Law itself found. The CSV URL is only the site root.

title: Law No. 21 of 2007 on the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons
topic: Trafficking, restitution
latest_amendment_date_official: 2023-01-02 (partial repeal of Art 2 by UU 1/2023, the Criminal Code, per the BPK status). Enacted 2007-04-19.
comment: CSV 'amended' is blank, but BPK lists 'Dicabut sebagian dengan UU No. 1 Tahun 2023 (KUHP)' for Art 2. The law otherwise remains in force. The Art 48 restitution right is unaffected. UU 1/2026 (penalty adjustment) not checked. No official English version found.

title: Government Regulation No. 59 of 2021 on the Implementation of the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers
topic: Division of duties between central and local government
comment: Matches the CSV year. Status 'Berlaku'. It repeals PP 3/2013, PP 5/2013, PP 4/2015 and Perpres 64/2011. Its scope is broader than the CSV topic: it also covers protection before, during and after work, P3MI duties (Art 86) and the OPP definition (Art 1(11)).

title: BP2MI Regulation No. 9 of 2020 on Exemption from Placement Costs
topic: Zero placement cost for ten occupations; implementation postponed in 2021
latest_amendment_date_official: 2021-02-01 (amended by Perban BP2MI 1/2021); REVOKED by Permen P2MI/BP2MI 17/2025, enacted 2025-08-19 and promulgated 2025-08-26. Enacted 2020-07-14.
comment: No longer in force: JDIH BP2MI shows 'TIDAK BERLAKU' for Perban 9/2020 and Perban 1/2021. Permen KP2MI/BP2MI 17/2025 on Placement Costs (Art 9) repealed both. The new rule makes the employer bear placement costs by default for all occupations (Art 2(6)), but Art 3 allows costs to fall on the worker where laws, agreements or cooperation agreements provide otherwise. The CSV entry is outdated. Kepka BP2MI 214/2021 is still shown 'BERLAKU' though its parent was revoked. The 2021 postponement claim is not verified (scanned PDF).

title: Manpower Regulation No. 4 of 2023 on Social Security for Migrant Workers
topic: BPJS coverage before, during and after placement
comment: Shown as 'Berlaku'; it repealed Permenaker 18/2018. KP2MI has since issued Permen P2MI/BP2MI 9/2026 on Social Security for Indonesian Migrant Workers (enacted 2026-08-24, promulgated 2026-08-28), implementing UU 18/2017 Art 29(5). It contains no explicit repeal of Permenaker 4/2023, so which instrument governs is unclear; cite the 2026 regulation alongside or instead.

title: Manpower Decision No. 260 of 2015 on halting placement with individual employers in Middle Eastern countries
topic: Domestic work in 19 countries; status to be confirmed
latest_amendment_date_official: not amended; signed 2015-05-26, in effect from 2015-07-01
comment: Still shown as 'Berlaku' on JDIH Kemnaker and JDIH BP2MI, so in force as far as both show. Annex lists 19 countries. It repealed Kepmenaker 221/2015. Kepmenaker 8/2026 (2026-01-20) repealed several PMI decisions, including Kepmenaker 291/2018 and 202/2023, but not 260/2015. Permen P2MI/BP2MI 3/2025 now sets the procedure for stopping or banning placement, without repealing 260/2015.

title: Constitution, Arts. 27(2), 28D(2) and 28I(2)
topic: Right to work and equal treatment
comment: Matches the CSV. Arts 27(2), 28D(2) and 28I(2) confirmed in the consolidated text. No official English version on the trusted sites.

title: Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995 (RA 8042)
topic: Licensing, joint liability, money claims, deployment policy
comment: Official text on SC E-Library (officialgazette.gov.ph blocked by Cloudflare). Amending RAs: RA 9422 (2007-04-10), RA 10022 (lapsed into law 2010-03-08), RA 11227 (2019-02-22) and RA 11299 (2019-04-17, inserts s.23(e) social welfare attachés). CSV 'amended=2010' is outdated: latest express amendment is RA 11299 (2019). RA 11641 (2021-12-30) merges POEA/OUMWA into DMW without express amendment.

title: RA 10022 amending RA 8042
topic: Compulsory insurance, certification of destinations, reintegration center
comment: Year correct; it lapsed into law on 8 Mar 2010 without the President's signature. Topic correct: compulsory insurance (s.37-A), certification of destinations (s.4), reintegration center (s.17).

title: Department of Migrant Workers Act (RA 11641)
topic: Creates the Department; Migrant Workers Offices abroad
comment: Approved 2021-12-30; IRR 2022-04-04; no amending RA found. s.15 creates Migrant Workers Offices, which absorb POLO and OSWA.

title: Overseas Workers Welfare Administration Act (RA 10801)
topic: Welfare fund and services
comment: Approved 2016-05-10; no amending RA. RA 11641 s.20 attaches OWWA to DMW and s.19(e) moves NRCO out of OWWA, without express amendment.

title: Office for Social Welfare Attaché Act (RA 11299)
topic: Social welfare attachés in destination countries
comment: Approved 2019-04-17. Amends RA 8042 by inserting s.23(e). RA 11641 s.15 and s.19(g) absorb OSWA into the Migrant Workers Office/DMW.

title: Expanded Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act (RA 9208 as amended by RA 10364 and RA 11862)
topic: Trafficking

title: Law on Vietnamese Workers Working Abroad under Contracts (No. 69/2020/QH14)
orig: Luật Người lao động Việt Nam đi làm việc ở nước ngoài theo hợp đồng
topic: Licensing, fees, orientation, support fund, returnees
comment: In force; issued 13/11/2020, effective 01/01/2022. Amended in part by Law on Prices 16/2023/QH15 and by Law 22/2026/QH16 (issued 24/08/2026, effective 01/03/2027, not yet in force), which amends Arts 3, 4, 7, 10, 17, 18, 21, 29-35, 39, 42 and 53 and repeals Arts 11-15 and 40. CSV 'amended' should show 2026 (pending). English record (vbpqta_11131) returned HTTP 404: unverified.

title: Decree 112/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law
topic: Licensing conditions, deposits
comment: Issued 10/12/2021. Amended by Decree 128/2025/NĐ-CP and Decree 372/2025/NĐ-CP (issued 31/12/2025, effective 01/01/2026). Consolidated text 08/VBHN-BNV (22/04/2026). vbpl.vn metadata says 'no longer in force' from 01/01/2026 but lists no replacement: likely a metadata error; treat as in force as amended. CSV 'amended' should be 2025.

title: Circular 21/2021/TT-BLDTBXH detailing the Law
topic: Fee and brokerage ceilings; amended by Circulars 02/2024 and 09/2026
comment: Partly in force. Amended by Circulars 08/2023, 02/2024 and 09/2026/TT-BNV (issued 15/05/2026, effective 30/06/2026). Circular 09/2026 Art. 4(3) repealed Circular 02/2024, so the topic note is outdated.

topic: Contributions and benefits
comment: No longer in force from 15/09/2025; replaced in full by Decision 34/2025/QĐ-TTg (https://vbpl.vn/van-ban/chi-tiet/quyet-dinh-so-34-2025-qd-ttg-ve-quy-ho-tro-viec-lam-ngoai-nuoc--187115). Cite Decision 34/2025.
